listings.title: Mediterranean Villa overlooking Roman Ruins
listings.description: A serene cliffside escape in Tipaza featuring direct sea views, private olive garden, and authentic architecture.

listings.title: Restored Historic Riad in Casbah of Algiers
listings.description: Experience the authentic heritage of the UNESCO-listed Casbah in an exquisitely restored 17th-century palace.

listings.title: Casbah Panoramic Artist Loft & Sea View Terrace
listings.description: Bohemian sunlit studio perched above the ancient alleyways of the Casbah, featuring cedar beam ceilings and private harbor-view roof terrace.

listings.title: Panoramic Seafront Penthouse in Oran
listings.description: High-floor apartment with sweeping views of the Santa Cruz fortress and Mediterranean coastline.

listings.title: Heritage Ottoman Residence near Rhumel Gorge
listings.description: Perched on the cliffside of Constantine, minutes from the suspension bridges with traditional carved cedar woodwork.

listings.title: Andalusian Garden Villa with Private Orchard
listings.description: Graceful estate with zellij mosaics, tranquil fountain patio, and mountain view in historic Tlemcen.

listings.title: Earthen Oasis Ksar in UNESCO M'zab Valley
listings.description: Traditional bioclimatic earthen home inside Ghardaïa palm groves with cool interior courtyards and rooftop star viewing.

listings.title: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado 4x4
listings.description: Robust all-terrain expedition SUV equipped for Sahara desert touring and mountain trails.
listings.mileagePolicy: Unlimited mileage in northern regions; Sahara permits provided.
listings.insuranceNotes: Comprehensive all-risk insurance included with standard deductible.

listings.title: Nissan Patrol Desert V8 Dune Edition
listings.description: Premium heavy-duty desert crosser fitted with dune sand tires, twin fuel tanks, and GPS beacon.
listings.mileagePolicy: Sahara zone unlimited, sand safety kit included.
listings.insuranceNotes: Full desert assistance & recovery insurance included.

listings.title: Dacia Duster 4WD Mountain Trail Edition
listings.description: Fuel-efficient all-wheel-drive crossover ideal for the Kabylie mountains, Aurès valleys, and coastal highways.

listings.title: Renault Clio 5 Turbo City Runner
listings.description: Modern compact car with Apple CarPlay, parking sensors, and low fuel consumption for Oran & Algiers city travel.
listings.pickupLocation: Ahmed Ben Bella Airport / Oran Center

listings.title: Guided 3-Day Sahara Expedition in Tassili n'Ajjer
listings.description: Journey into the mystical sandstone canyons, prehistoric rock art, and starry dunes of Djanet with local Tuareg guides.

listings.title: Taghit Grand Erg Occidental Sunset Caravan & Oasis Dinner
listings.description: Camel caravan ride through the golden dunes of Taghit followed by an authentic dinner under the stars by an ancient palm grove.

listings.title: Casbah Heritage Food Tour & Traditional Cooking Class
listings.description: Stroll the Ottoman alleys of Algiers Casbah, pick fresh spices, and prepare traditional Rechta and Makroud with a master chef.

listings.title: Hotel El Djazaïr Boutique & Suites
listings.description: A prestigious botanical palace hotel nestled in Hydra, Algiers, surrounded by century-old gardens. Offering luxurious suites and classic guest rooms with signature Algerian hospitality.

roomTypes.name: Deluxe King Garden View
roomTypes.description: Spacious 38m² bedroom featuring a King-size bed, private marble bath, and balcony facing botanical gardens.

roomTypes.name: Ambassador Executive Suite
roomTypes.description: Premium 65m² luxury suite with separate salon lounge, panoramic city views, and VIP lounge access.

roomTypes.name: Prestige Family Suite (2 Bedrooms)
roomTypes.description: Two connecting bedrooms with 1 King and 2 Twin beds, ideal for visiting families.

listings.title: Casbah Medina Nomad Hostel & Rooftop
listings.description: An authentic historic house transformed into a vibrant cultural hostel in the heart of the UNESCO Casbah. Features panoramic bay view rooftop, social café, and mixed & female dorms plus private rooms.

roomTypes.name: 6-Bed Mixed Dormitory Bed
roomTypes.description: Handcrafted wooden bunk bed with private reading light, USB charger, privacy curtain, and secure under-bed locker.

roomTypes.name: 4-Bed Female Dormitory Bed
roomTypes.description: Dedicated female-only dorm room with en-suite shower, vanity mirror, and lockers.

roomTypes.name: Private Rooftop Double Room
roomTypes.description: Private room on the top floor with Double bed, traditional ceramic tiles, and direct rooftop terrace access.

listings.title: Royal Hotel Oran MGallery Heritage
listings.description: A neo-classical 5-star palace in the vibrant heart of Oran overlooking the Mediterranean harbor. Features fine-dining restaurants, private art collection, luxury wellness spa, and signature baroque suites.

roomTypes.name: Superior Sea-View King Room
roomTypes.description: Elegant 34m² room with high ceilings, Italian marble en-suite, and French balcony looking over Oran Bay.

roomTypes.name: Imperial Diplomatic Suite
roomTypes.description: Opulent 85m² suite with authentic colonial woodwork, living salon, private dining area, and harbor vistas.

listings.title: Taghit Oasis Backpacker & Palm Hostel
listings.description: A community-centered adobe youth hostel at the foot of the Grand Erg Occidental dunes. Includes shaded palm courtyards, rooftop stargazing lounge, traditional music evenings, and shared desert bivouac treks.

roomTypes.name: Dune-View Mixed 8-Bed Dorm
roomTypes.description: Bunk bed crafted from palm wood with personal reading light, locker, and direct desert dune breezes.

roomTypes.name: Private Saharan Adobe Room
roomTypes.description: Cool clay brick room with Queen-size bed, handmade Berber carpets, and private clay washroom.

trips.title: 5-Day Grand Tassili n'Ajjer & Tamrit Rock Art Expedition
trips.description: An awe-inspiring 5-day walking and 4x4 expedition through the geological wonderland of Tassili n'Ajjer National Park. Walk among millennia-old cypress trees, camp under unpolluted Saharan skies, and witness prehistoric rock paintings that depict the Sahara when it was green and lush.
trips.meetingPoint: Djanet Inedbirene Airport (DJA) or Agency Office, Djanet Center

itinerary.title: Djanet Arrival & Ascent to Plateau Base
itinerary.description: Reception at Djanet Inedbirene Airport by our Tuareg expedition team. Briefing over traditional mint tea, 4x4 transfer through golden dunes to the base of the Tassili plateau cliff pass.
activities: Airport greeting & gear verification
4x4 scenic transfer across Admer erg borders
Campfire dinner & stargazing orientation
itinerary.accommodation: Desert Bivouac tent at plateau base

itinerary.title: Ascent to Tamrit Canyon & Millennium Cypress Trees
itinerary.description: Early morning climb via the ancient donkey trail onto the lunar sandstone plateau. Walk through the canyon of thousand-year-old Dupreziana cypress trees and discover first prehistoric rock engravings.
activities: Scenic 4-hour guided plateau ascent
Exploration of prehistoric pastoralist murals
Tamrit natural rock arch photography

itinerary.title: Sefar Stone Labyrinth: World's Open-Air Art Museum
itinerary.description: Full-day trek into the surreal stone labyrinth of Sefar. Admire the world-renowned frescoes of the 'Great God of Sefar' and scenes of hunters, giraffes, and ancient rituals.
activities: Guided tour of central Sefar prehistoric shelters
Tuareg geological and archaeological lecture
Traditional Taguella sand-bread preparation
itinerary.meals: Breakfast, Trail Lunch, Traditional Taguella Dinner

itinerary.title: Tin Zoumaitek & Jabbaren Panorama
itinerary.description: Traverse the eastern plateau edge toward Tin Zoumaitek to marvel at the famed 'Weeping Cows' bas-reliefs. Breathtaking sunset over the boundless erg dunes below.
activities: Visit the Weeping Cows rock engravings
Panoramic sunset viewpoint over the Grand Erg
Tuareg music and storytelling circle

itinerary.title: Plateau Descent, Oasis Bath & Djanet Farewell
itinerary.description: Gentle morning descent back to the desert floor. Relaxing warm tea ceremony at Essendilene canyon oasis, souvenir craftsmanship visit in Djanet, and airport transfer.
activities: Descent via scenic mountain pass
Essendilene green palm oasis visit
Traditional farewell banquet in Djanet oasis garden

inclusions: All internal 4x4 ground transport in Toyota Land Cruisers
Licensed Tuareg mountain guide and National Park certified ranger
Official Tassili n'Ajjer National Park entry and photography permits
Full board: breakfasts, trail lunches, and hot campfire dinners with chef
Quality two-person tents, thick sleeping mats, and dining mess tent
Mule and porter team for collective luggage and camp supplies
exclusions: Domestic flights to/from Djanet (Air Algérie / Tassili Airlines)
Personal sleeping bag and trekking poles
Travel, mountain rescue and medical insurance

trips.title: 3-Day Golden Dunes & Mudbrick Ksar Caravan of Taghit
trips.description: Discover the jewel of the Saoura Valley. Climb the highest sand dunes in the Grand Erg Occidental, explore ancient 11th-century mudbrick ksars, and experience sunset camel treks with traditional campfire mint tea.
trips.meetingPoint: Béchar Airport (CBH) or Taghit Oasis Center

itinerary.title: Welcome to Saoura Valley & Sunset Camel Trek
itinerary.description: Arrival in Taghit, check-in at our authentic mudbrick guest house. Afternoon camel caravan across the red sands of the Grand Erg Occidental for a 360-degree dune sunset.
activities: Arrival and date milk welcome drink
2-hour camel ride into the high dunes
Sunset dune summit meditation & photography
itinerary.accommodation: Traditional adobe lodge in Taghit palm grove

itinerary.title: 11th-Century Old Ksar & Prehistoric Petroglyphs
itinerary.description: Guided morning walk through the maze of the historic mudbrick Ksar of Taghit. Afternoon excursion to prehistoric rock art stations featuring desert gazelles and ostriches.
activities: Architectural exploration of the Ksar fortifications
Oasis irrigation segregation system tour
Zaouia and petroglyphs archaeological visit

itinerary.title: Béni Abbès Hermitage & Grand Erg Panorama
itinerary.description: Morning excursion to neighboring Béni Abbès, the white pearl of the Saoura. Visit the historical Father de Foucauld hermitage and museum before departure.
activities: Visit Father de Foucauld historic hermitage
Museum of Sahara flora and fauna
Return transfer to Béchar Airport

inclusions: Airport transfers from/to Béchar Airport in air-conditioned 4x4
2 nights accommodation in authentic adobe guesthouse
All meals mentioned in the itinerary (local Saharan gastronomy)
Guided camel ride with local caravaneer
Certified local cultural tour guide
exclusions: Quad / buggy rental on the dunes (optional add-on)

trips.title: 4-Day M'zab Valley & Ghardaïa Millennium Heritage Circuit
trips.description: A deep cultural journey through the five sacred pentapolis ksars of the UNESCO M'zab Valley. Meet local architects, observe traditional craft carpet auctions in Beni Isguen, and study millennium-old hydraulic oasis systems.

itinerary.title: Beni Isguen Silent City & Sunset Auction
itinerary.description: Arrival in Ghardaïa. Afternoon walking tour of the fortified holy city of Beni Isguen, strictly preserved according to Ibadi customs. Watch the famous afternoon silent market auction.
activities: Private tour with a local certified Mozabite guide
Ascent to the Boulila watchtower panoramic viewpoint
Experience the historic carpet and antique open-air auction

itinerary.title: Ghardaïa Old Town & Hydraulic Oasis Ingenuity
itinerary.description: Explore the capital ksar of Ghardaïa with its pyramid-shaped minaret that inspired Le Corbusier. Walk through the millennial subterranean dam network and lush palm groves.
activities: Architecture lecture on functional desert urbanism
Visit the ancient flood distribution water-gates
Traditional mint tea with date growers

itinerary.title: El Atteuf & Melika: The Oldest Foundations
itinerary.description: Visit El Atteuf, the first ksar founded in 1012 AD, and its world-renowned Mosque of Sidi Brahim. Continue to Melika for royal cemetery views over the wadi.
activities: Visit the UNESCO-listed Sidi Brahim sanctuary
Artisan pottery and textile weaving workshop
Mozabite family dinner experience

itinerary.title: Craft Markets & Farewell to the Pentapolis
itinerary.description: Morning shopping in the vibrant covered souks of Ghardaïa for authentic wool rugs, pure dates, and copperware. Airport transfer.
activities: Shopping in the spice and carpet souks
Farewell lunch with traditional trida dish
Transfer to Ghardaïa Airport

inclusions: Airport transfers and private Mercedes van transport between ksars
3 nights lodging in authentic restored Mozabite villa
Full board including all home-cooked traditional meals
Official certified local Mozabite guide throughout
All community entrance fees and donations

trips.title: 3-Day Roman Caesarea & Mediterranean Coast Heritage Circuit
trips.description: Explore the ancient Phoenician and Roman maritime ports of Tipaza and Cherchell, climb the majestic Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania, and sample coastal Mediterranean culinary traditions.
trips.meetingPoint: Algiers Central Station or Tipaza Port

itinerary.title: Tipaza UNESCO Roman Ruins & Royal Mausoleum
itinerary.description: Morning departure from Algiers. Visit the enigmatic Royal Mausoleum of Mauretania (Tombeau de la Chrétienne). Afternoon stroll through the maritime Roman amphitheater, basilica, and olive presses overlooking the turquoise Mediterranean.
activities: Guided tour of the Royal Mausoleum
Walk through the seaside Roman ruins praised by Albert Camus
Sunset seafood dinner in Tipaza Port

itinerary.title: Cherchell Antiquities & Juba II's Capital
itinerary.description: Follow the scenic coastal cornice west to Cherchell (ancient Caesarea). Visit the archaeological museum hosting priceless marble statues of Cleopatra Selene and King Juba II.
activities: Cherchell archaeological museum tour
Roman forum and public baths exploration
Traditional coastal fish barbecue

itinerary.title: Mount Chenoua Hike & Artisan Pottery Village
itinerary.description: Morning coastal hike along the cliffs of Mount Chenoua with panoramic views of the bay. Visit the artisan potters of Chenoua village before return transfer to Algiers.
activities: Scenic 2-hour coastal nature walk
Hands-on pottery workshop with local craftswomen
Return drive to Algiers

inclusions: Comfortable minibus transport throughout from/to Algiers
2 nights seaside accommodation in Tipaza
All meals including fresh Mediterranean seafood specialties
Certified archaeological tour guide & all museum entrance tickets

messages.text: Salam Amina! Is early check-in possible for the seaside villa in Tipaza?
Marhaban Yacine! Yes, absolutely. The cleaning team finishes by 1:30 PM, so you can arrive anytime after 2:00 PM.
Thank you Amina, we will arrive at 3:00 PM tomorrow.
Hi Karim, does the Land Cruiser come equipped with desert recovery tracks for the Taghit dunes?
The 4x4 Prado will be waiting for you at Houari Boumediene Airport with sand tracks, air compressor, and satellite phone included.
Welcome to Algiers! Mint tea and traditional makroud will be served on arrival on the Casbah terrace.
